characters.name: Rodion Romanovitch Raskolnikov
characters.description: A destitute former student living in a Petersburg garret; central protagonist who struggles with poverty, theory, and conscience and confesses to the murders.

characters.name: Sofya Semyonovna Marmeladov (Sonia)
characters.description: A young woman forced into prostitution to support her stepfamily; compassionate, religious, and Raskolnikov’s confidante.

characters.name: Semyon Zakharovitch Marmeladov
characters.description: An indebted, alcoholic titular counsellor whose tragic life and death affect his family; father of Sonia.

characters.name: Katerina Ivanovna Marmeladov
characters.description: Marmeladov’s consumptive, proud, and suffering wife who struggles to care for her children.

characters.name: Pulcheria Alexandrovna Raskolnikov
characters.description: Raskolnikov’s devoted, anxious mother who travels to Petersburg and suffers from worry and illness.

characters.name: Avdotya Romanovna Raskolnikov (Dounia)
characters.description: Raskolnikov’s proud, strong-willed sister whose proposed marriage and moral integrity shape key plot events.

characters.name: Dmitri Prokofitch Razumihin
characters.description: An open-hearted, energetic former student and loyal friend who befriends the Raskolnikov family and helps Rodion.

characters.name: Nastasya
characters.description: Servant/cook in Raskolnikov’s lodging-house who cares for him and attends the household.

characters.name: Alyona Ivanovna
characters.description: A cruel, miserly old pawnbroker whose murder sets the central crime in motion.

characters.name: Lizaveta Ivanovna
characters.description: The pawnbroker’s meek, submissive sister and secondary murder victim.

characters.name: Amalia Lippevechsel
characters.description: The German widow landlady of the lodging-house block who houses many tenants and presides over household affairs.

characters.name: Praskovya Pavlovna
characters.description: A landlady who appears in the lodging-house domestic scenes and interacts with Raskolnikov and others.

characters.name: Pyotr Petrovitch Luzhin
characters.description: A stilted, self-important, moneyed suitor of Avdotya whose proposed marriage raises moral tensions.

characters.name: Porfiry Petrovitch
characters.description: The investigating magistrate handling the pawnbroker murder; thoughtful, clever, and psychologically probing.

characters.name: Zossimov
characters.description: A young physician who examines and treats Raskolnikov; practical and observant about mental and physical conditions.

characters.name: Alexandr Grigorievitch Zametov
characters.description: A junior official/clerical acquaintance who appears in investigation-related and social scenes.

characters.name: Ilya Petrovitch
characters.description: An assistant superintendent at the police office who questions locals in the murder inquiry.

characters.name: Koch
characters.description: A witness/suspect connected with the pawnbroker murder case; appears in accounts of events at the building.

characters.name: Pestryakov
characters.description: A man initially suspected or questioned in connection with events at the pawnbroker’s building.

characters.name: Nikolay Dementyev
characters.description: A journeyman house-painter and workman who becomes implicated and at one point falsely confesses to the murders.

characters.name: Dmitri (painter)
characters.description: A colleague/journeyman painter who worked with Nikolay at the house where the murder occurred.

characters.name: Dushkin
characters.description: A dram-shop keeper who finds a jewel case and gives testimony that influences the investigation.

characters.name: Kapernaumov
characters.description: A tailor/householder who provides lodging for Sonia and whose household figures in key scenes.

characters.name: Kozel
characters.description: A German cabinet-maker whose rooms house Katerina Ivanovna’s family and scenes of domestic life.

characters.name: Polenka
characters.description: One of Katerina Ivanovna’s young daughters who runs errands and appears at the funeral and household scenes.

characters.name: Lida
characters.description: One of Katerina Ivanovna’s young daughters who participates in family and street scenes.

characters.name: Kolya
characters.description: One of Katerina Ivanovna’s young sons who appears in family rituals and performances.

characters.name: Arkady Ivanovitch Svidrigaïlov
characters.description: A wealthy, morally ambiguous landowner connected to Dounia’s past who intervenes in several characters’ affairs.

characters.name: Marfa Petrovna
characters.description: Svidrigaïlov’s late wife whose death and legacy influence his behavior and Dounia’s history.

characters.name: Andrey Semyonovitch Lebeziatnikov
characters.description: A progressive-minded lodger/clerk whose talkativeness and meddling affect social incidents and testimony.

characters.name: Tchebarov
characters.description: A businessman mentioned in connection with pawnshop debts and transactions.

characters.name: Vassily Ivanovitch Vahrushin
characters.description: A merchant referenced as having aided Pulcheria Alexandrovna and the family in the provinces.

characters.name: Ivan Afanasyvitch
characters.description: An official mentioned by Marmeladov as having helped him obtain a position.

characters.name: Pokorev
characters.description: A student acquaintance who once gave Raskolnikov the pawnbroker’s address.

characters.name: Darya Frantsovna
characters.description: A woman of ill repute mentioned in Marmeladov’s account and local slanders around Sonia.

characters.name: Nikodim Fomitch
characters.description: A named official referenced in conversation about investigative contacts.

characters.name: Madame Resslich
characters.description: A landlady mentioned as Svidrigaïlov’s neighbour or host in Petersburg.

characters.name: Philip
characters.description: A waiter at a tavern encountered by Svidrigaïlov; a minor participant in listening scenes.

characters.name: Katia
characters.description: A young singer/performer in tavern scenes who receives small sums from Svidrigaïlov.

characters.name: Achilles
characters.description: A small man in a helmet standing by hotel gates who appears briefly near Svidrigaïlov’s stops.

characters.name: Fedosya
characters.description: A cook mentioned in Svidrigaïlov’s household who helps secure presents and domestic arrangements.

characters.name: the commissariat clerk
characters.description: An unnamed, drunken lodger who attends the memorial dinner and instigates conflict.

characters.name: the Pole (unnamed)
characters.description: Unnamed Polish lodgers/visitors who attend the memorial dinner and interact with Katerina Ivanovna.
